name: Ripcord
author: weedwhitesandwine
description: Pair a USB drive to your machine and carry it on a lanyard. If the drive is pulled out, the session locks — and, if you ask it to, the machine sleeps. A rehearsal mode lets you test the trap without springing it.

barWidget.description: Arms a paired USB drive as a physical tether: pull it out and the session locks
